title: mut.channel_sage_jenson_physarum
mutation_directive: Channel Sage Jenson (mxsage) — physarum slime-mold simulation. Replace whatever motion the piece has with an agent-based system: each particle is an agent that (1) deposits a small amount of pheromone into a 2D trail texture, (2) senses pheromone density at three small offsets ahead-left, ahead, ahead-right, and (3) steers toward the strongest. Use a feedback texture (ping-pong RT) for the pheromone field with slight diffusion + decay each frame. Render the trail as the visual — organic webs, neural-net-like structure, biological feel. This is the SOTA fxhash aesthetic from 2024-2025.
